<h3>What M6 asks of the technical side</h3><div class="ws-cards"><div class="ws-card"><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3b/">J3b</a><b>Taifafeki vaccines are fitted to the Onesan schedule</b><p><span class="ws-t">What the system does</span>Code map between neighbours' vaccine products.</p></div><div class="ws-card"><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J4.0b/">J4.0b</a><b>Dad creates a link to share at the clinic</b><p><span class="ws-t">What the system does</span>Regional IPS + immunization profile with national extensions.</p></div><div class="ws-card"><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J4.1/">J4.1</a><b>A Taifafeki doctor sees the full history</b><p><span class="ws-t">What the system does</span>Connectathon test of issuer, gateway and viewer.</p></div></div>
<h3>Terms at those steps</h3><div class="ws-terms"><a href="glossary.html#term-terminology-service" title="The Terminology Service is a governed, publicly accessible service that manages, publishes, and provides access to the standardised terminologies, code systems, value sets, and concept maps used across the digital health ecosystem.">Terminology Service</a><a href="glossary.html#term-core-data-set" title="The elements a country agrees to record for a use case, each mapped to standard codes. Also called a minimum data set.">Core data set</a><a href="glossary.html#term-logical-information-model" title="The agreed structure of the data: elements, types and rules, independent of any software.">Logical information model</a><a href="glossary.html#term-snomed-ct" title="Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms is a structured clinical terminology standard for use in electronic health records.">SNOMED CT</a><a href="glossary.html#term-decision-support-engine" title="The Computable Decision Support Engine is a governed, shared application component that delivers context-appropriate, evidence-based guidance at the point of clinical decision-making by applying computable clinical rules and knowledge artefacts to person-specific health data.">Computable Decision Support Engine</a><a href="glossary.html#term-smart-guidelines" title="Standards-based, Machine-readable, Adaptive, Requirements-based, Testable Guidelines are a comprehensive set of reusable digital health components (e.g., interoperability standards, code libraries, algorithms, technical and operational specifications) that transform the guideline adaptation and implementation process to preserve fidelity and accelerate uptake. SMART Guidelines provide a five-step pathway to advance the adoption of best clinical and data practices, even if a country is not yet fully digital.">SMART Guidelines</a><a href="glossary.html#term-digital-adaptation-kit" title="Software-neutral L2 content: personas, workflows, core data dictionary, decision logic, indicators and requirements.">Digital adaptation kit</a><a href="glossary.html#term-dose-number-and-series" title="Which dose this is, out of how many in the schedule. Needed to work out what is due next.">Dose number and series</a><a href="glossary.html#term-expanded-programme-on-immunization" title="The national immunization programme.">Expanded Programme on Immunization</a><a href="glossary.html#term-international-patient-summary" title="A standard minimal health summary, including immunizations, readable across borders.">International Patient Summary</a><a href="glossary.html#term-hl7-fhir" title="FHIR is a standard for healthcare data exchange, published by HL7®">Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources</a><a href="glossary.html#term-implementation-guide" title="A FHIR specification for one use case: profiles, codes and tests. It can be adopted rather than authored.">Implementation guide</a><a href="glossary.html#term-profile" title="A FHIR resource tailored to a use case, for example by making some fields required.">Profile</a><a href="glossary.html#term-consent" title="A person's permission for their data to be used or shared. Rules for minors and dependants differ by country.">Consent</a><a href="glossary.html#term-procurement-conditions" title="Requirements written into tenders, such as conformance to the national IG, that steer what suppliers build.">Procurement conditions</a><a href="glossary.html#term-application-programming-interface" title="A defined, documented way for one system to ask another for data.">Application programming interface</a><a href="glossary.html#term-global-digital-health-certification-network" title="WHO Global Digital Health Certification Network. A trust network so countries can verify each other's health documents. Countries onboard per use case.">Global Digital Health Certification Network</a><a href="glossary.html#term-trust-list" title="A published list of keys accepted as valid issuers. The GDHCN shares these between countries.">Trust list</a><a href="glossary.html#term-health-information-exchange" title="The layer that routes data securely between systems.">Health information exchange</a><a href="glossary.html#term-lifelong-health-record" title="The Lifelong Health Record (LHR) is one or more governed data repositories, whether physically consolidated or virtually federated, that collectively maintain a longitudinal, person-centred record of an individual's key health information across care settings and over their lifetime.">Lifelong Health Record</a></div>
